title: Maneki Mania turns petting a lucky cat into an endless fortune machine
summary: You’ve almost certainly seen one. A little gold cat sat by the till in a takeaway, one paw going up and down, doing its best to bring the owner some luck. Maneki Mania takes that cat, puts it in a shrine, and hands the paw over to you. Maneki Mania is an incremental from Lianes8 Studio. You pet the cat, koban pop out with a bit of confetti, and every pet also charges a fortune meter. Fill it and a lever lights up, which spins a set of charm slots. Pairs pay, three of a kind pays five times a pair, and a full board of koban is the jackpot. ... [MORE]

title: Seolhwa Dungeon turns Korean folktales into deadly roguelike rules
summary: Beetlejuice is summoned only when you take his name three times. Jeoseung Saja, the grim reaper in Seolhwa Dungeon, works the other way round. He calls your name once for every turn he can see you, and on the third call, you’re the one who disappears. That’s a fair taste of how Seolhwa Dungeon, a turn-based roguelike RPG, goes about things. Seolhwa means folktale in Korean, and solo devel Sungki Soft has built the whole dungeon out of them, so the stories aren’t just set dressing. They’re the rules. ... [MORE]

title: Hoshikage is a one-fingered sword-battling action game that lets you feel like an anime heroine
summary: I think it's safe to say that Asia's swordplay has completely supplanted anything Europe or beyond has to offer. After all, a shiny sword from Camelot isn't quite as cool as cutting the clouds in flight, or whatever your metaphor of choice is. And newly released sword battler Hoshikage lets you feel exactly like that wuxia, anime-style hero effortlessly taking on your enemies. What makes Hoshikage stand out is that you use only a single finger to play. With hordes of enemies attacking you left and right, you need to parry and deflect their blows in particular sequences, leaving them staggered. Once all your foes are seeing spots before their eyes, it's time to unleash an Issen, a devastating blow to cut them all down at once. ... [MORE]

title: Wavy Road is a quirky little endless runner that's launching with its own Halloween event
summary: Endless runners are a constant favourite on mobile, and for good reason. They're easy to pick up, hard to put down, and, depending on the developer, can have all kinds of interesting twists on a simple format. And that's what Wavy Road is setting out to achieve, with its quirky endless runner action coming to iOS on October 21st. Wavy Road stands out because you aren't following a track, but laying it yourself. As you move your vehicle, the road ahead will similarly twist and turn, with the objective being (obviously) to avoid obstacles. As you twist the road, you'll need to watch what your vehicle of choice is doing, and keep it on track for as long as possible. ... [MORE]

title: Heat: Pedal to the Metal brings fast-paced, nitro-fuelled racing board game action to mobile
summary: Nowadays we're used to racing games being all about high-octane, fast-paced and flashy visuals. But Heat: Pedal to the Metal, the upcoming digital adaptation of Asmodee's hit board game, takes a different tack. Instead of split-second decisions, you'll weigh your moves carefully in high-octane races that can still twist on a dime. Heat: Pedal to the Metal is a card-based board game that sees you playing as drivers in the heyday of 1960s racing. High speed, low safety, and four different maps covering recreations and amalgamations of iconic tracks across the USA, Britain, Italy, France and Germany. You'll need to decide when to accelerate, when to maintain your position and when to go for that crucial overtake. ... [MORE]

title: RuneScape Reignited axed by development team but temporary free membership will go ahead
summary: It was one of the more surprising and divisive reveals at RuneFest 2026. RuneScape Reignited was a separate, siloed-off economy where players began at level three and could explore Gielinor at their own pace. While the excitement was palpable, so was the discontent, and now, RuneScape Reignited has been shelved for good. As explained by Mod Ryan, RuneScape Reignited's rather lacklustre response from existing fans, especially regarding a separate economy and other issues, has led to them axing plans to launch it this December. It's an important step from the folks at Jagex, who have been working to regain player trust throughout 2026 with their Road to Restoration roadmap. ... [MORE]

title: Outerplane ramps up 1st Anniversary Bunny Moon Party with costumes and mini-games, and you're invited
summary: Bunny rabbits will always have their appeal, even when they're on a different world entirely - and that's never been truer within the isekai adventure, Outerplane! Continuing its festivities for the 1st Service Transfer Anniversary, Major9's anime-style RPG is adding even more content for the 1st Anniversary Bunny Moon Party, which means that you can look forward to keeping the celebration going come October 20th. That's because pre-registrations for Outerplane's anniversary content have already surpassed 200,000 sign-ups, proving just how pumped everyone seems to be for the Bunny Moon Party - so much so that the RPG actually hit first place on Google Play's Top Free RPG Games chart in Japan. Outerplane also bagged second place in South Korea, so it's safe to say the hype is very much real. To celebrate this milestone, Major9 is planning a surprise gift for all players around the October 20th update, so stay tuned! ... [MORE]

title: UFL hits 10 million mobile downloads and finally adds controller support
summary: Ten million downloads is a fair few people kicking a ball about on the bus. That’s where UFL on mobile has got to across iOS and Android, roughly five months after its soft launch went global back in May. Controller support was added last week as well, and I’d say that’s the more useful of the two bits of news. Touchscreen football has always asked a lot of your thumbs, and this started life on PS5 and Xbox, so letting you pair a pad feels like the obvious move. Both DualShock and DualSense controllers work, wired or over Bluetooth. Handy if you’ve already got one sitting next to the telly. ... [MORE]

title: Nominations for the Pocket Gamer Awards 2027 Are Now Open!

Well, now is the time for you to make you voice heard and to celebrate and champion the games that have filled your spare moments over the year because the Nominations stage of the Pocket Gamer Awards 2027 are now open!It's our thirteenth year running these fantastic awards, and every year it gets tougher and tougher to pick out the cream of the crop, so we're looking to you - dear readers - to nominate your favourite games, developers, characters and more. You know the story... the plucky hero is down on their luck with nowhere to turn and suddenly they remember their past experiences and turn the tide, becoming a champion as they overcome all the odds. Well, now's your time to become a champion - a champion for the mobile games (and more) that have brought you joy over the year. But, don't worry, you won't need to swipe a glaive at a hydra's throat, or gut a goblin with a swift swipe of a scimitar (at least, not this year), here you'll be playing champion by making your voice heard and filling out a nice little form that you can find over on our nominations page. ... [MORE]

title: Xbox announces new Nano Controller that's also compatible with mobile
summary: Xbox have announced their latest peripheral, and in a break from the norm, it's going smaller rather than bigger. The Xbox Nano Controller has opened pre-orders and will debut later this year, becoming the smallest Xbox controller yet, with some other surprising features. The Xbox Nano Controller is their smallest, full-fledged controller yet. It features all the same inputs you've come to expect, as well as a reprogrammable action button. And, rather interestingly, it's also fully compatible with mobile! It's both that compatibility and the deal they're offering that makes this such an interesting product. ... [MORE]

title: Gundam Blitz Order brings the hit mecha anime to mobile with a new auto-battler
summary: With years of spinoffs and hit series under its belt, Mobile Suit Gundam is a franchise even non-anime fans have heard of. Now, those of you who want to jump into the Universal Century and beyond will soon be able to, with the announcement of Gundam Blitz Order! Gundam Blitz Order has just been announced, so details are still a bit sketchy. But by the looks of things, this is an idle RPG that brings together characters and mobile suits from across the Gundam franchise. You'll organise your own squad, send them out into battle and even take on bosses based on some of the most iconic adversaries of the series. ... [MORE]

title: Sifu, the critically acclaimed martial arts brawler, is out now on mobile
summary: As we head towards the weekend, you may already be deciding what you're going to dip your toes into. And you're already spoilt for choice, but it might well be worth taking a second glance because Sifu, the critically acclaimed martial-arts brawler, is available now on iOS and Android! Sifu takes a classic story of kung-fu revenge and transplants it into the modern day. Playing as a martial arts student, you'll fight to avenge your fallen master and father by kicking and punching your way through multiple levels. It's one part Ip Man, one part Police Story and just a touch of John Wick. ... [MORE]
